description: This file contains report generation logic for HSN-wise summary of outward supplies, including data retrieval, processing, and JSON export functions within an ERPNext/Frappe framework.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main entry point for report execution, calls internal _execute with filters.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Fetches data, computes taxes, merges data, and returns report columns and data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines and returns the report columns for HSN summary.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves sales invoice items matching filters from the database.

methods.name: get_tax_accounts
methods.description: Calculates item-wise tax details and prepares tax columns.

methods.name: get_merged_data
methods.description: Merges rows with same HSN code by summing numeric fields.

methods.name: get_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON report with GST details based on filters and report data.

methods.name: download_json_file
methods.description: Prepares and triggers download of the JSON report file.

methods.name: get_hsn_wise_json_data
methods.description: Formats report data into JSON structure for GST reporting.
